rules.title: Thick Cloud Layers Rule
rules.approximation_note: Cloud cover is estimated from relative humidity on ten pressure levels at one grid point. Layer thickness is quantised to level spacing. The cirriform and radar exemptions cannot be evaluated, so this proxy over-reads.

plot.readout_phrase: have a cloud layer 1,400 m or thicker between 0 and -20 °C

rules.title: Cumulus Cloud Rule
rules.approximation_note: CAPE and cloud cover are convective stand-ins. One grid point cannot resolve cloud type, distance or the published exemptions.

plot.readout_phrase: have convective cloud reaching -5 °C (CAPE 300 J/kg or more with precipitation above 0.254 mm/h and cloud cover at least 30%)

rules.title: Anvil Cloud Rules
rules.approximation_note: CAPE and high cloud cover stand in for a thunderstorm and anvil. Distance, cloud age and exemptions cannot be resolved.

plot.readout_phrase: have a thunderstorm with a high cloud shield in the grid cell (CAPE 1,000 J/kg or more, precipitation above 2.54 mm/h and high cloud at least 50%)

rules.title: Disturbed Weather Rule
rules.approximation_note: Cloud cover is a stand-in for non-transparent cloud. Model output cannot establish flight-path distance or radar exemptions.

plot.readout_phrase: have precipitation above 2.54 mm/h under cloud cover at least 30% below 0 °C

rules.title: Flight Through Precipitation
rules.approximation_note: Named in official Falcon concerns. The vehicle threshold is not public; this proxy uses the LLCC precipitation detection definition.

rules.title: Liftoff wind
rules.approximation_note: NASA fact sheet FS-2020-05-568-KSC: published for crewed Falcon 9; applied to all Falcon 9 and Falcon Heavy as the only public figure.

plot.readout_phrase: exceed 13.4 m/s (49.4 m above the pad)

not_evaluable.title: Lightning
not_evaluable.reason: Needs observed lightning distance and timing; the ensemble has no lightning field.

not_evaluable.title: Surface Electric Fields
not_evaluable.reason: Field-mill readings are not public in real time.

not_evaluable.title: Booster recovery and downrange weather
not_evaluable.reason: Recovery zone and downrange limits are mission-specific and not public.
